<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈133.102 Da. The formula C₆H₁₅O₂N gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of 133.110 Da, which matches the observed mass within a few ppm, making it the best candidate. The required format is CxHyOzX, with X = N.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H15O2N</final_answer>
